messages.text: For a Semiconductor use case involving RFIC validation, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

**Signaling Tester**: fits in the **R&D test / debug / validation** part of the workflow when validation needs a real signaling environment, RF TX/RX characterization, DUT connectivity, mobility/application/RF testing, or pre-conformance-style checks; CMX500 is described as a callbox for DUT connection and RF/pre-conformance testing, and as an R&D signaling/interworking tester for measuring RF TX/RX characteristics under real-world signaling conditions [1][7][18].
**Non-signaling Tester**: fits in **fast RF measurement / production-oriented validation** when RF measurements can be executed without protocol signaling; CMP180 is positioned for production non-signaling RF testing, where all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time [14][21].
**Workflow framing**: a “virtual tester” workflow spans **implementation → test → debug → validation**, so these testers would sit in the **test/debug/validation** portions rather than being the whole workflow by themselves [12][15].
